orgNames.title: Organization names
orgNames.description: Names attackers might use to impersonate you, e.g. ["Acme", "Acme Corp"].

orgDomains.title: Organization email/web domains
orgDomains.description: Your real domains, e.g. ["acme.com"]. Mail from these is trusted; look-alikes are flagged.

trustedLoginHosts.title: Trusted sign-in pages
trustedLoginHosts.description: Your SSO or portal hosts, e.g. ["acme.okta.com"].

reportWebhook.title: Optional report webhook
reportWebhook.description: HTTPS URL that receives a JSON copy of each report (e.g. a ticketing or chat webhook).

enableLookups.title: Enable DNS and RDAP lookups
enableLookups.description: Sends domain names (never email contents) to dns.google and rdap.org.

weights.title: Signal weight overrides
weights.description: Map of signal id to points, e.g. {"free_provider": 5}.
